gifFavorites.description: GIFs saved from the picker, stored whole. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

composerState.description: The contents of the user's social.colibri.beta.actor.composerState record. Replaces the stored copy whole. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

shareActivity.description: Whether the AppView may show what the user is listening to. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

communityOrder.description: Communities in preferred sidebar order. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

clientPreferences.description: The contents of the user's social.colibri.beta.actor.clientPreferences record. Replaces the stored copy whole. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

notificationLevel.description: Which messages produce a notification. Absent leaves the current value unchanged.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A field is present but does not hold an allowed value.

preferences.description: The requesting user's settings, after the update.

main.description: Pushes the requesting user's social.colibri.beta.actor.settings record to the AppView, so it takes effect immediately instead of waiting for a sync notification. The client writes the record to its own personal space first, then calls this. An absent field leaves the current value unchanged.
